HeEyzrVWeU6gy_OYnV0hWw.name: [60Brawl] Slivers
HeEyzrVWeU6gy_OYnV0hWw.primerEnglish:
## Playstyle

Aggressive snowball 5-color Sliver tribal deck that floods the board with synergistic creatures, turning them into an unstoppable horde through shared abilities like haste, protection, recursion, and evasion.

[The first sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22The%20first%20sliver%22) commands, cascading into new slivers to easily populate the board.

Although not having a bursting early-game, it will snowball in the late game via [Echocasting Symposium](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Echocasting%20Symposium%22) or [Reflections of Littjara](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Reflections%20of%20Littjara%22) to copy Slivers exponentially for overwhelming wins.

## Main Features
- **Sliver Core:** [Bonescythe Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Bonescythe%20Sliver%22), [Cloudshredder Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Cloudshredder%20Sliver%22), [Cleaving Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Cleaving%20Sliver%22), [Sliver Hivelord](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sliver%20Hivelord%22), [Sliver Overlord](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sliver%20Overlord%22). Grant doublestrike, flying, first strike, indestructible, and tutoring to dominate combat. 
- **Ramp:** [Manaweft Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Manaweft%20Sliver%22), [Cryptolith Rite](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Cryptolith%20Rite%22), [Urza's Incubator](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Urza's%20Incubator%22) or [Utopia Sprawl](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Utopia%20Sprawl%22). Turn Slivers into mana dorks and accelerate multicolored casts. 
- **Protection:** [Diffusion Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Diffusion%20Sliver%22), [Sliver Hivelord](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sliver%20Hivelord%22), [Dregscape Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Dregscape%20Sliver%22). Provide shroud, indestructible, and recursion to survive wipes and removal.
- **Interaction:** [Abrupt Decay](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Abrupt%20Decay%22), [Anguished Unmaking](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Anguished%20Unmaking%22), [Leyline Binding](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Leyline%20Binding%22), [Void Rend](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Void%20Rend%22), [Lavabelly Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Lavabelly%20Sliver%22). Versatile removal and pings to clear blockers or threats.
- **Tutors:** [Sliver Overlord](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sliver%20Overlord%22), [Worldly Tutor](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Worldly%20Tutor%22). Search precisely for the perfect Sliver to adapt to any board state. 
- **Card advante:** Not much, you are an aggro deck. However [Hollowhead Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Hollowhead%20Sliver%22) can get rid of dead cards.
- **Tokens:** Did you want some extra basic Slivers? [Thrumming Hivepool](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Thrumming%20Hivepool%22), [Hive Stirrings](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Hive%20Stirrings%22) or [Sliver hive](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sliver%20hive%22) will give them to you.
- **Copies:** If you did not have enough with the previous suit, duplicate your favorite creatures! [Echocasting Symposium](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Echocasting%20Symposium%22), [Reflections of Littjara](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Reflections%20of%20Littjara%22) will duplicate key Slivers or spawn armies to snowball out of control in long games.

## Complexity: 3/5
Intuitive tribal swarm, BUT **mana fixing** and Overlord tutors demand awareness amid chaos.

Vulnerable to wipes without Hivelord; excels in mid-long games.

## Estilo de Juego

Mazo tribal Sliver de 5 colores agresivo y con snowball que inunda el tablero con criaturas sinérgicas, convirtiéndolas en una horda imparable gracias a habilidades compartidas como prisa, protección, recursión y evasión.

[The First Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22The%20First%20Sliver%22) comanda, creando una cascada de nuevos slivers para poblar fácilmente el tablero.

Aunque no tiene un inicio explosivo, snowball en el late game mediante [Echocasting Symposium](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Echocasting%20Symposium%22) o [Reflections of Littjara](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Reflections%20of%20Littjara%22) para copiar Slivers exponencialmente y ganar de forma abrumadora.

## Características Principales
- **Núcleo de Slivers:** [Bonescythe Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Bonescythe%20Sliver%22), [Cloudshredder Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Cloudshredder%20Sliver%22), [Cleaving Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Cleaving%20Sliver%22), [Sliver Hivelord](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sliver%20Hivelord%22), [Sliver Overlord](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sliver%20Overlord%22). Otorgan doble golpe, vuelo, primer golpe, indestructible y tutoría para dominar el combate. 
- **Aceleración:** [Manaweft Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Manaweft%20Sliver%22), [Cryptolith Rite](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Cryptolith%20Rite%22), [Urza's Incubator](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Urza's%20Incubator%22) o [Utopia Sprawl](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Utopia%20Sprawl%22). Convierten Slivers en mana dorks y aceleran lanzamientos multicolores. 
- **Protección:** [Diffusion Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Diffusion%20Sliver%22), [Sliver Hivelord](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sliver%20Hivelord%22), [Dregscape Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Dregscape%20Sliver%22). Proveen velo, indestructible y recursión para sobrevivir limpiezas y remociones.
- **Interacción:** [Abrupt Decay](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Abrupt%20Decay%22), [Anguished Unmaking](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Anguished%20Unmaking%22), [Leyline Binding](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Leyline%20Binding%22), [Void Rend](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Void%20Rend%22), [Lavabelly Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Lavabelly%20Sliver%22). Remoción versátil y pings para limpiar bloqueadores o amenazas.
- **Tutores:** [Sliver Overlord](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sliver%20Overlord%22), [Worldly Tutor](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Worldly%20Tutor%22). Buscan con precisión el Sliver perfecto para adaptarse a cualquier estado del tablero. 
- **Ventaja de cartas:** No mucha, eres un mazo aggro. Sin embargo [Hollowhead Sliver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Hollowhead%20Sliver%22) puede deshacerse de cartas muertas.
- **Tokens:** ¿Querías algunos Slivers básicos extra? [Thrumming Hivepool](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Thrumming%20Hivepool%22), [Hive Stirrings](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Hive%20Stirrings%22) o [Sliver Hive](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sliver%20Hive%22) te los darán.
- **Copias:** Si no tenías suficiente con lo anterior, ¡duplica tus criaturas favoritas! [Echocasting Symposium](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Echocasting%20Symposium%22), [Reflections of Littjara](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Reflections%20of%20Littjara%22) duplicarán Slivers clave o generarán ejércitos para snowball fuera de control en partidas largas.

## Complejidad: 3/5
Enjambre tribal intuitivo, PERO **fijación de mana** y tutores de Overlord demandan atención en medio del caos que se pueda generar.

Vulnerable a limpiezas de campo sin Hivelord; destaca en partidas medianas-largas.

zydoid1aJk28Y4gMS0VWiw.primerEnglish:
## Playstyle

Aggresive Boros Equipment Warrior deck centered on voltron (i.e. one single creature with many equipments) aggression, suiting up efficient attackers to deal massive combat damage. The strategy deploys cost-reduced gear on warriors, tutors staples for specific equipments and efficient removal effects.

Bruenor Battlehammer leads as commander, giving free equipment attachment.


## Main Features

- **Equipment Core:** [Shadowspear](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Shadowspear%22), [Umezawa's jitte](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Umezawa's%20jitte%22), [Buster Sword](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Buster%20Sword%22), [Sword of Fire and Ice](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sword%20of%20Fire%20and%20Ice%22). Pump damage, draw cards, remove blockers, or add protection. Cheap equipments to optimise aggresion.
- **Equip Efficiency:** [Sigarda's Aid](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sigarda's%20Aid%22), [Fighter Class](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Fighter%20Class%22), [Blacksmith's Talent](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Blacksmith's%20Talent%22), [Forge Anew](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Forge%20Anew%22). Enable free or instant-speed attachments to keep momentum.
- **Warriors:** The duellers wielding the weapons. [Goblin Gaveleer](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Goblin%20Gaveleer%22), [Bladegraft Aspirant](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Bladegraft%20Aspirant%22), [Kazuul's Toll Collector](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Kazuul's%20Toll%20Collector%22), [Raubahn, Bull of Ala Mhigo](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Raubahn%2C%20Bull%20of%20Ala%20Mhigo%22), [Sokka, Swordmaster](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sokka%2C%20Swordmaster%22). Provide haste, recursion, and synergy for repeated equipped hits.
- **Ramp:** [Diamond Pick-Axe](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Diamond%20Pick-Axe%22), [Goldvein Pick](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Goldvein%20Pick%22). Accelerate into power to deploy more warriors and weapons in future turns.
- ** Tutors:** ; [Enlightened Tutor](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Enlightened%20Tutor%22), [Open the Armory](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Open%20the%20Armory%22) find the best tool for each scenario
- **Removal:** [Swords to Plowshares](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Swords%20to%20Plowshares%22), [Resolute Strike](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Resolute%20Strike%22), [Rebel Salvo](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Rebel%20Salvo%22), [Stroke of Midnight](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Stroke%20of%20Midnight%22), [Chained to the Rocks](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Chained%20to%20the%20Rocks%22), [Chainsaw](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Chainsaw%22). While this is not a deck that focus much on removal, it aims to handle creatures and paths cleanly. 
- **Protection:** [Lightning Greaves](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Lightning%20Greaves%22), [Celestial Armor](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Celestial%20Armor%22), [Resistance Reunited](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Resistance%20Reunited%22), [Flawless Maneuver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Flawless%20Maneuver%22). Safeguard key threats from any removal. With flash-y equipments, you can also abuse some combat tricks. 


## Complexity: 2.5/5

Aggro-voltron is intuitive, but optimal play and damage involves timing flash equips, Bruenor's triggers, and interaction to chain advantages without stumbling.

Mazo agresivo Boros de Equipamiento Guerrero centrado en voltron (es decir, una sola criatura con muchos equipamientos encima) agresivo, equipando atacantes eficientes para infligir daño masivo en combate. Bruenor Battlehammer lidera como comandante, permitiendo adjuntar equipo de forma gratuita.

- **Núcleo de Equipamiento:** [Shadowspear](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Shadowspear%22), [Umezawa's Jitte](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Umezawa's%20Jitte%22), [Buster Sword](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Buster%20Sword%22), [Sword of Fire and Ice](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sword%20of%20Fire%20and%20Ice%22). - **Eficiencia de Equipamiento:** [Sigarda's Aid](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sigarda's%20Aid%22), [Fighter Class](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Fighter%20Class%22), [Blacksmith's Talent](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Blacksmith's%20Talent%22), [Forge Anew](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Forge%20Anew%22). Permiten adjuntos gratuitos o a velocidad de instantáneo para mantener el impulso.

[Goblin Gaveleer](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Goblin%20Gaveleer%22), [Bladegraft Aspirant](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Bladegraft%20Aspirant%22), [Kazuul's Toll Collector](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Kazuul's%20Toll%20Collector%22), [Raubahn, Bull of Ala Mhigo](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Raubahn%2C%20Bull%20of%20Ala%20Mhigo%22), [Sokka, Swordmaster](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sokka%2C%20Swordmaster%22). Proporcionan prisa, recursión y sinergia para golpes equipados repetidos.
- **Aceleración:** [Diamond Pick-Axe](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Diamond%20Pick-Axe%22), [Goldvein Pick](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Goldvein%20Pick%22). Acelera el poder para desplegar más guerreros y armas en turnos futuros.
- **Tutores:** [Enlightened Tutor](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Enlightened%20Tutor%22), [Open the Armory](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Open%20the%20Armory%22) encuentran la mejor herramienta para cada escenario.
- **Remoción:** [Swords to Plowshares](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Swords%20to%20Plowshares%22), [Resolute Strike](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Resolute%20Strike%22), [Rebel Salvo](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Rebel%20Salvo%22), [Stroke of Midnight](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Stroke%20of%20Midnight%22), [Chained to the Rocks](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Chained%20to%20the%20Rocks%22), [Chainsaw](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Chainsaw%22). Aunque no es un mazo que se centre mucho en remoción, busca manejar criaturas y caminos de forma limpia.
- **Protección:** [Lightning Greaves](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Lightning%20Greaves%22), [Celestial Armor](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Celestial%20Armor%22), [Resistance Reunited](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Resistance%20Reunited%22), [Flawless Maneuver](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Flawless%20Maneuver%22). Protegen amenazas clave de cualquier remoción. Con equipos a destello, también puedes abusar de algunos trucos de combate.

## Complejidad: 2.5/5

El aggro-voltron es intuitivo, pero el juego óptimo implica cronometrar cuando equipar a destello, los habilidades disparadas de Bruenor e interacción para encadenar ventajas sin tropezar.

zVlzsMZdz0SCsXssPb_x_Q.primerEnglish:
## Playstyle

Midrange-combo Orzhov vampire deck that combines combat damage with life drain and sacrifice. [Elenda, the Dusk Rose](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Elenda%2C%20the%20Dusk%20Rose%22) seeks to take advantage of sacrifice effects to grow stronger and eventually generate new bodies as offerings.

The deck’s idea is to win through cumulative drain, triggered abilities from sacrifice, or by assembling the necessary pieces for an infinite combo.

## Main Features

- **Drain:** [Cruel Celebrant](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Cruel%20Celebrant%22), [Susurian Voidborn](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Susurian%20Voidborn%22), [Vengeful Bloodwitch](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Vengeful%20Bloodwitch%22) and other aristocrats (i.e. creatures with drain), as well as enchantments like [Funeral Room](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Funeral%20Room%22) or [Sanguine Bond](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sanguine%20Bond%22), drain the opponent’s life. Ideally, you want one of your creatures to die to trigger those abilities.  
- **Offerings (Sac Target):** Every sacrifice requires offerings. [Bloodghast](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Bloodghast%22), [Oathsworn Vampire](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Oathsworn%20Vampire%22), etc., can return from the graveyard recursively. [Martyr of Dusk](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Martyr%20of%20Dusk%22) and [Sanguine Evangelist](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sanguine%20Evangelist%22) act as double offerings. [Elenda, the Dusk Rose](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Elenda%2C%20the%20Dusk%20Rose%22) can benefit from the sacrifice effects and later be sacrificed herself to create new offerings.  
- **Removal:** [Fatal Push](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Fatal%20Push%22), [Deadly Rollick](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Deadly%20Rollick%22), [Damn](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Damn%22), along with other spells that require a sacrifice such as [Flare of Malice](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Flare%20of%20Malice%22) or [Rite of Oblivion](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Rite%20of%20Oblivion%22).  
- **Resources (Draw):** Keep your card resources flowing with [Village Rites](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Village%20Rites%22) or [Fanatical Offering](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Fanatical%20Offering%22), which also serve as sacrifice activators.  
- **Infinite Combo(s):** (Easy to assemble with [Vampiric Tutor](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Vampiric%20Tutor%22) and [Forerunner of the Legion](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Forerunner%20of%20the%20Legion%22))  
   * [Sanguine Bond](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sanguine%20Bond%22) + [Bloodthirsty Conqueror](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Bloodthirsty%20Conqueror%22) = You gain life → opponent loses life → repeat infinitely.  
   * [Exquisite Blood](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Exquisite%20Blood%22) + [Marauding Blight-Priest](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Marauding%20Blight-Priest%22) = Opponent loses life → you gain life…  
   * [Bloodthirsty Conqueror](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Bloodthirsty%20Conqueror%22) + [Marauding Blight-Priest](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Marauding%20Blight-Priest%22) = Same loop.  

## Complexity: 4/5

This deck has a midrange focus. While it can have explosive starts, it requires patience and good judgment to know when it’s best to sacrifice something to trigger an ability. The card synergy can be tricky, and not knowing the details may lead to sub-optimal or even bad plays.

## Estilo de Juego

Mazo midrange-combo de vampiros Orzhov que combina daño de combate con drenaje de vida y sacrificio. [Elenda, the Dusk Rose](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Elenda%2C%20the%20Dusk%20Rose%22) busca aprovecharse de los efectos para sacrificar criaturas para crecer y eventualmente generar nuevos cuerpos como ofrenda.

La idea del mazo es ganar por drenaje acumulativo, habilidades disparadas por sacrificio o consiguiendo ensamblar las piezas necesarias para un combo infinito.

## Características Principales

- **Drenaje (Drain):** [Cruel Celebrant](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Cruel%20Celebrant%22), [Susurian Voidborn](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Susurian%20Voidborn%22), [Vengeful Bloodwitch](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Vengeful%20Bloodwitch%22) u otros aristócratas (i.e. criaturas con drenaje), así como encantamientos [Funeral Room](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Funeral%20Room%22) o [Sanguine Bond](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sanguine%20Bond%22) drenan vida del oponente. Lo ideal es conseguir que alguna de tus criaturas muera para desencadenar las habilidades disparadas.
- **Ofrendas (Sac Target):** Todo sacrificio requiere de ofrendas. [Bloodghast](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Bloodghast%22), [Oathsworn Vampire](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Oathsworn%20Vampire%22), etc. pueden regresar del cementerio de manera recursiva. [Martyr of Dusk](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Martyr%20of%20Dusk%22) y [Sanguine Evangelist](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sanguine%20Evangelist%22) sirven como doble ofrenda. [Elenda, the Dusk Rose](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Elenda%2C%20the%20Dusk%20Rose%22), puede aprovecharse de los efectos de sacrificio y ser sacrificada posteriormente, para generar nuevas ofrendas.
- **Remoción (Removal):** [Fatal Push](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Fatal%20Push%22), [Deadly Rollick](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Deadly%20Rollick%22), [Damn](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Damn%22), junto con otros hechizos que requieren de sacrificio, como [Flare of Malice](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Flare%20of%20Malice%22) o [Rite of Oblivion](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Rite%20of%20Oblivion%22).
- **Recursos (Draw):** Mantén los recursos siempre disponibles con [Village Rites](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Village%20Rites%22) o [Fanatical Offering](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Fanatical%20Offering%22), que además son cartas que sirven como activadores de sacrificio.
- **Combos Infinito(s):** (Fáciles de ensamblar con [Vampiric Tutor](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Vampiric%20Tutor%22) y [Forerunner of the Legion](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Forerunner%20of%20the%20Legion%22))
   * [Sanguine Bond](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sanguine%20Bond%22) + [Bloodthirsty Conqueror](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Bloodthirsty%20Conqueror%22) = Ganas vida → oponente pierde vida → repite infinitamente.
   * [Exquisite Blood](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Exquisite%20Blood%22) + [Marauding Blight-Priest](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Marauding%20Blight-Priest%22) = Opo pierde vida → Ganas vida...
  * [Bloodthirsty Conqueror](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Bloodthirsty%20Conqueror%22) + [Marauding Blight-Priest](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Marauding%20Blight-Priest%22) = Lo mismo.

## Complejidad: 4/5

Este mazo tiene un enfoque midrange. Si bien puede tener inicios explosivos, requiere de paciencia y juicio para poder determinar cuando conviene realizar un sacrificio para disparar alguna habilidad. La sinergia de las cartas puede ser complicada y no conocer sus entresijos puede provocar jugadas sub-óptimas o incluso malas.

W5-gXmh4CU67_2M1mG-pLg.primerEnglish:
## Playstyle

Midrange Selesnya Angels tribal deck (with taxing) that builds a wide flying board of resilient Angels, generating lifegain, tokens, and overwhelming aerial combat pressure. The plan ramps into early Angels, taxes opponents while gaining life, then snowballs with token generators and board protection for mid-to-late dominance.

[Sigarda, Font of Blessings](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Sigarda%2C%20Font%20of%20Blessings%22) commands, granting protection and extra cards to be play from top-deck.

## Main Features

- **Angel Core:** [Lyra Dawnbringer](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Lyra%20Dawnbringer%22), [Resplendent Angel](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Resplendent%20Angel%22), [Righteous Valkyrie](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Righteous%20Valkyrie%22), [Giada, Font of Hope](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Giada%2C%20Font%20of%20Hope%22), [Bishop of Wings](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Bishop%20of%20Wings%22). Generate tokens, lifegain, vigilance, and flying beaters to control skies.
- **Ramp:** [Avacyn's Pilgrim](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Avacyn's%20Pilgrim%22), [Farseek](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Farseek%22), [Rampant Growth](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Rampant%20Growth%22), [Giada, Font of Hope](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Giada%2C%20Font%20of%20Hope%22), [Utopia Sprawl](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Utopia%20Sprawl%22). Accelerate into expensive Angels quickly. You can also accelerate with [Starheirn Aspirant](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Starheirn%20Aspirant%22) or [Herald's horn](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Herald's%20horn%22)
- **Protection:** [Shalai, Voice of Plenty](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Shalai%2C%20Voice%20of%20Plenty%22), [Serra the Benevolent](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Serra%20the%20Benevolent%22), [Platinum Angel](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Platinum%20Angel%22). Hexproof, indestructible, and win-cons to survive removal and wipes.
- **Interaction:** [Banishing Light](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Banishing%20Light%22), [Wrath of God](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Wrath%20of%20God%22), [Winds of Abandon](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Winds%20of%20Abandon%22), [Devout Decree](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Devout%20Decree%22). Exile threats and clear ground while preserving your air superiority.
- **Taxes:** [Authority of the Consuls](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Authority%20of%20the%20Consuls%22), [Land Tax](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Land%20Tax%22), [Deafening Silence](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Deafening%20Silence%22), [Metropolis Reformer](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Metropolis%20Reformer%22). Slow opponents, gain incremental advantages.
- **Lifegain:** [Angel of Vitality](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Angel%20of%20Vitality%22), [Cleric Class](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Cleric%20Class%22), [Righteous Valkyrie](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Righteous%20Valkyrie%22), [The Book of Exalted Deeds](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22The%20Book%20of%20Exalted%20Deeds%22). Stabilize against aggro and enable resilient plays.
- **Draw:** [Inspiring Overseer](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Inspiring%20Overseer%22), [Exemplar of Light](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Exemplar%20of%20Light%22), [Wojek Investigator](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Wojek%20Investigator%22). Refill hand through combat and Angel triggers.
- **Semi-combo:**
     - [Platinum Angel](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22Platinum%20Angel%22)/[The book of exalted deeds](https://scryfall.com/search?q=!%22The%20book%20of%20exalted%20deeds%22) + Hexproof effect: Will give you extra time until opponent can find board wipe.

## Complexity: 2/5

Midrange tribal synergies are straightforward. Due to high CMC of creatures, it is important to choose which creature to play each turn, as it will be common to only play one creature/effect each of your turns.

Weak to fast combo; thrives against midrange and aggro.

Ralentizan a los oponentes y generan ventajas incrementales.
